groups.requirement: Admit complete4x4 list/tuple shapes before arithmetic and require exact GaussianRational entries; export immutable tuple rows. Admit exactly four rational momentum coordinates and mass, excluding bool/float/text. Lorentz index is exact integer0..3. Compose shared Gaussian arithmetic, with every resulting component bounded and no local duplicate scalar implementation.

Construct the immutable Dirac representation with gamma0 diagonal(+,+,-,-) and spatial Pauli off-diagonal blocks of opposite sign. Use signature(+---) for slash and lowered indices. Private gamma construction only receives0..3 from the fixed family initialization.

DiracKernel owns exact momentum and signed mass. Its inverse operator slash(p)-mI is defined also on shell. Propagator requires nonzero p0^2-p1^2-p2^2-p3^2-m^2, checks every square and prefix, and computes(slash(p)+mI)/denominator with a rational reciprocal. Return both operations through Outcome, with singular input and resource failure distinct. Legacy prop/prop_inv helpers retain matrix-valued semantics with typed failures via the outer boundary.

Dirac contraction sums gamma_nu A eta_nu gamma_nu. Factor vertex as dirac(left gamma_mu right), preserving order. Lower a supplied q with(+---) before summing four vertices. Admit every matrix/index/vector before dependent operations; test nonreal noncommuting matrices and nonzero spatial q, not just the original sparse witness.

Require Cases and record25 actual mathematical obligations, including all16 Clifford pairs and both sides of both supplied propagator inversions in addition to original inverse differences/sandwich/contraction/witness. Preserve exact witness fractions, emit JSON and nonzero expected failure exit; unexpected programming errors and cancellation propagate.
